#!/bin/sh

docker run --rm \
  --network host \
  -v /home/ubuntu/work/fisgon:/app \
  -v /home/ubuntu/data_storage:/home/ubuntu/data_storage \
  -w /app \
  -e OPERATION=0 \
  -e TARGET_CITY=${TARGET_CITY} \
  -e TARGET_SCRAPER=${TARGET_SCRAPER} \
  fisgon_scraper:1.0

#!/bin/sh

docker run --rm \

  -v /home/ubuntu/work/fisgon:/app \
  -v /home/ubuntu/data_storage:/home/ubuntu/data_storage \
  -w /app \
  -e TARGET_CITY=${TARGET_CITY} \
  -e OPERATION=${OPERATION} \
  -e CREATE_SESSION=${CREATE_SESSION} \
  -e CLOSE_SESSION=${CLOSE_SESSION} \
  -e SESSION=${SESSION} \
  -e IMAGES=${IMAGES} \
